title: Get set up
description: Three steps to reach a real security posture. Progress is read from the actual state of your organization, not from anything you tick by hand.
completeDescription: Your organization is connected, watching repositories and scanning.

import_repository.title: Import a repository

run_first_scan.description: Launch a pentest against a repository or a domain to get real findings.
